launchPhaseDetail: South Korea's first bank-led KRW stablecoin proof-of-concept; built by iM Bank and Finger on the Kaia blockchain; features quantum-resistant (PQC) security via BTQ Technologies and Keypair. BTQ's Q1 2026 filing reports the precursor Finger pilot completed 1,477 production transactions at 100% success with 200+ post-quantum wallets, and names iM Bank as its lead commercial conversion candidate. A real token (iMKRW) has now been issued and transacted on Kaia across two closed pilots — the OpenAsset full-lifecycle PoC (May 2026) and the Coocon/Beatoz payment-ecosystem PoC (July 2026) — so Pharos marks the phase testnet; these are private pilots, not a public testnet, commercialization remains gated on Korean stablecoin legislation, and the production symbol/ticker is not yet confirmed
